hero.title: Author Guidelines & Manuscript Submission Framework
hero.subtitle: AUTHOR GUIDELINES & SUBMISSION
hero.content: Publish your original research, review articles, and clinical discoveries with the **Gono Bishwabidyalay Journal of Research**. We offer rigorous double-blind peer review, an average of 18 days to first decision, no article processing charges, and open access under CC BY 4.0.

meta.noteText: Authors must provide an editable manuscript (DOCX/LaTeX), anonymized peer-review version, and signed ethical declaration of originality.

article-types.label: Article Formats
article-types.description: Heading, intro and per-type details (word limit, description, structure). Card names come from the journal's article type list; details are matched by name.
article-types.title: Manuscript Categories & Requirements
article-types.subtitle: ACCEPTED FORMATS
article-types.content: Select the article format that best represents your study design, evidence base, and intended scholarly contribution.

types.name: Research Article
types.description: Original empirical investigations, laboratory experiments, clinical trials, or field studies presenting novel findings.
types.structure: Abstract · Introduction · Materials & Methods · Results · Discussion · References

types.name: Review Article
types.description: Comprehensive, critical evaluations of published literature identifying current knowledge gaps and future research trends.
types.structure: Abstract · Introduction · Methodological Synthesis · Thematic Sections · Future Directions · References

types.name: Case Study
types.description: In-depth explorations of specific institutional interventions, clinical cases, legal precedents, or community health initiatives.
types.structure: Abstract · Introduction · Case Presentation · Diagnostic / Intervention Assessment · Discussion · References

types.name: Short Communication
types.description: Concise preliminary reports of significant findings, methodological innovations, or urgent scientific discoveries.
types.structure: Abstract · Context & Findings · Methods Summary · Results & Implications · References

types.name: Perspective
types.description: Scholarly, evidence-informed opinions offering fresh interpretations of pressing academic debates or emerging controversies.
types.structure: Abstract · Current Scholarly Context · Critical Perspective · Policy & Research Implications · References

types.name: Editorial
types.description: Authoritative commentary from the Editorial Board or guest editors highlighting thematic volumes, policy reforms, or symposium topics.
types.structure: Executive Overview · Thematic Synthesis · Editorial Call to Action · References

types.name: Letter
types.description: Scholarly correspondence offering constructive critiques, secondary analyses, or extensions of recently published articles in GB Journal.
types.structure: Specific Article Reference · Methodological Critique · Corroborating Data · References

types.name: Policy Brief
types.description: Action-oriented analyses translating rigorous scientific evidence into actionable public health, agricultural, or legal policy directives.
types.structure: Executive Summary · Policy Context · Evidence Critique · Concrete Policy Recommendations · References

fallbackType.description: Scholarly research contribution meeting journal standards.
fallbackType.structure: Abstract · Introduction · Methods · Results · Discussion · References

preparation-checklist.label: Prep Checklist
preparation-checklist.description: Submission package heading, intro, benefit notes, portal button and the checklist cards
preparation-checklist.title: Complete Submission Package Checklist
preparation-checklist.subtitle: SUBMISSION PREPARATION
preparation-checklist.content: Ensure every element is prepared before starting the online submission workflow. Submissions with complete metadata and properly formatted anonymized files proceed directly to review without administrative delay.

benefits.label: No Article Processing Charges:
benefits.text: Publishing is fully funded by the university.

benefits.label: Author Copyright:
benefits.text: Authors retain copyright; articles are published under CC BY 4.0.

items.title: Main Editable Manuscript
items.desc: Complete document (DOCX or LaTeX) with title, abstract, keywords, body sections, tables, and references.
items.spec: Double-spaced, 12pt Times New Roman, line numbering enabled.

items.title: Anonymized Blinded Review Copy
items.desc: A separate version with all author names, institutional affiliations, acknowledgments, and self-identifying citations excised for double-blind review.
items.spec: Required for peer review. No institutional identifiers.

items.title: Title Page & Author Affiliations
items.desc: Standalone document listing full author names, institutional affiliations, ORCID IDs, and corresponding author email address.

items.title: Structured Abstract & Keywords
items.desc: A 250-word structured abstract (Background, Methods, Results, Conclusions) alongside 4–6 MeSH/thematic index keywords.
items.spec: No undefined abbreviations or uncited references.

items.title: Ethics & Compliance Declarations
items.desc: Formal statements declaring Institutional Review Board (IRB) approval, informed patient/subject consent, funding sources, and conflict of interest.
items.spec: Mandatory for all clinical, animal, and human studies.

items.title: High-Resolution Artwork & Tables
items.desc: Figures submitted as standalone 300+ DPI TIFF/PNG files. Tables provided in editable format with clear captions and footnotes.
items.spec: RGB/CMYK 300 DPI minimum for photographs and micrographs.

editorial-pathway.label: Editorial Pathway
editorial-pathway.description: Heading, intro and the five publication workflow stage cards (same lifecycle as the About page)
editorial-pathway.title: The 5-Stage Peer Review & Publication Journey
editorial-pathway.subtitle: EDITORIAL PATHWAY
editorial-pathway.content: From initial file upload to CrossRef DOI indexation, experience an accountable and transparent editorial pathway.

stages.title: Manuscript Submission
stages.text: Authors submit files, structured abstracts, author affiliations, conflict of interest declarations, and ethical approval certificates via the online portal.

stages.title: Initial Desk Screening
stages.text: The Editor-in-Chief and Associate Editors check journal scope, academic originality, and similarity (< 15% via automated plagiarism screening).

stages.title: Double-Blind Peer Review
stages.text: Manuscripts are assigned to two or more independent external reviewers. Author and reviewer identities remain concealed.

stages.title: Revisions & Editorial Decision
stages.text: Authors receive reviewer comments and the editorial decision (Accept, Minor Revision, Major Revision, or Reject). Revisions are re-evaluated promptly.

stages.title: Production & Open Access
stages.text: Accepted papers undergo copyediting, typesetting, CrossRef DOI registration, and open-access publication.

formatting-specs.label: Formatting Specs
formatting-specs.description: Technical specifications heading, intro and the formatting / citation / data cards
formatting-specs.title: Formatting, References & Data Protocols
formatting-specs.subtitle: TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS
formatting-specs.content: Standardized formatting guidelines ensuring seamless copyediting, machine indexability, and cross-disciplinary citation clarity.

cards.title: APA 7th Edition Citations
cards.description: All references must follow the American Psychological Association (APA) 7th Edition format. Inclusion of active https://doi.org/... links is mandatory for all digital sources.
cards.footnote: Format: Author, A. (Year). Title. Journal, Vol(Issue), Pages. DOI

cards.title: 300+ DPI High-Resolution Figures
cards.description: Graphics, charts, and micrographs must be submitted in TIFF, PNG, or vector PDF format at 300 DPI minimum for color and 600 DPI for line drawings.
cards.footnote: Vector / 300 DPI raster with clear axis units and legends

cards.title: Open Data & FAIR Availability
cards.description: Authors are strongly encouraged to deposit raw underlying datasets and code in open scholarly repositories (Dryad, Zenodo, Figshare, GitHub) with permanent DOIs.

cta.title: Ready to Publish Your Research?
cta.subtitle: CALL FOR PAPERS
cta.content: We welcome original research in health, pharmacy, agriculture, law, computing, and social welfare. There are no submission or publication fees.
